title: Streams, Process Lifecycle & Graceful Shutdown
objectives: Stream large payloads instead of buffering
Configure the process via environment with validation

examples.name: shutdown.js

exercise.prompt: Order SIGTERM handling: "server.close() stops new connections", "SIGTERM arrives", "in-flight requests finish", "process exits".
hints: The signal comes first; then refuse new work.
Existing requests get a bounded window to complete.

questions.prompt: Streaming a file to a client beats reading it fully because…
options: memory stays constant regardless of file size
questions.explanation: Backpressure-aware streams move chunks; buffering loads everything into RAM.

questions.prompt: On SIGTERM a production server should…
options: stop accepting and finish in-flight requests
questions.explanation: Draining turns deploys from dropped requests into a non-event.
